description: If you're tired of cheat clients or visuals, you can relax with this mod. It includes over 20 different features aimed at improving the game's quality of life. Version: 1.21.11. Targeted at Russian anarchist projects. Future plans: Add over 40 new features and adapt the mod for multi-server play.

releases.notes:
- Added a new feature "Better Anti-Invisible" - reveals players while invisible.
- Added a new feature "Better Zoom" - reveals players while invisible.
- Added a new FunTime setting in "Better Mine."
- Added a new feature "Better Gamma" - increases in-game brightness.
- Added a new feature "Better Hit Color" - custom player model color upon hit.
- Added a new feature "Better Hitboxes" - hitbox improvements.
- Added full English localization. Functions that work on Russian-language servers will work in Russian.
- Improved structure for "Better Spheres," "Better Totems," and "Better RCT."
- Reworked the Config structure.
- Improved client performance.

- Updated to version 1.21.11.
- Added Sodium support.
- Removed unnecessary PvP mode from Better Movement.
- Fixed ReallyWorld RCT.
- Fixed HolyWorld RCT.
- Added new spheres to Better Spheres ReallyWorld.
- Added new totems to Better Totems ReallyWorld.
- Fixed Better Fog.
- Fixed Better Prefixes.
- Fixed Better Health.
- Added a new Better Prefixes setting - Lightning.
- Added a new Better Liquid feature: Water Color and Lava Color change the color of liquids, Water Transparency and Lava Transparency change the transparency of liquids, and Water Intensity and Lava Intensity change the color intensity of liquids.
- Added new spheres to Better Spheres ReallyWorld.
- Improved client performance.

mods.description: Better Quality of Life. The mod is in BETA TEST. SOON I will add work with the HolyWorld API (LITE API). There is currently no support and the mod may be BANNED on some servers

releases.notes:
- Added a new "Better Totems" feature - a totem-specific "Better Spheres" module, plus a module that counts totems knocked down from opponents.
- Improved "BetterRCT" functionality.
- Improved "Better Prefixes" functionality. A chat display bug was fixed.
- Fixed LiteAPI functionality.
- Added "FakeTime" mode to "Better RCT."
- Added a new "Better Hit Counter" feature - displays a series of hits.
- Added a new "Better Chat" feature - numerous chat improvements, from stacked messages to goals next to nicknames.
- Optimized Show Blocks in Better Tnt.

- Support for version 1.20.1 is ending (possibly temporarily). The mod will be written for version 1.21.11.

releases.notes:
A huge number of things have been added, so much so that I've almost forgotten what I needed to add. However, I'll summarize:
- At least two new features have been added
- Mod stability has been improved
- Numerous bugs have been fixed
- The main screen has been improved

This is a major update, so I recommend upgrading to this version!

releases.notes:
- Added new function "Better TNT":
- Timer - timer over dynamite until it explodes.
- Alert - when there is dynamite set on fire nearby, a plaque with information appears.
- Alert Location - changeable location of the tile.
- Show XYZ - display of dynamite coordinates
- Added new feature "Better Holograms":
- Visible Stand - allows you to see Armor stands if they are hidden.
- Anti-Holograms - Cancels the rendering of all holograms.
- Added a second page of sounds to Better Sounds.
- Even more sounds have been added to Better Sounds.
- Now you can walk even with the GUI mod open.
- Fixed scrolling and added a scroll bar.
- Fixed a bug with the display of most spheres in Better Spheres
- Fixed a bug with disabling custom color in Better Sky

- "Safe Harves"t allows you to avoid damage to crops that have not yet been grown.
- Updated the display order of binds.
- New ReallyWorld mode added to Better Spheres.
- Removed Customize Names and Customize Parameters from Better Spheres HolyWorld.

- Better Sprint has improved Default mode and PvP mode.
- Tree mode removed from Better Sprint.
